title: Descriptor-relative artifact path validation and local SHA-256 digest store
commit_message: feat(artifacts): add descriptor-relative path and digest validation

deliverables.description: PathResolver: per-tenant held dir fd; openat2(RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS|RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS) via libc::syscall(SYS_openat2) with component-wise openat(O_NOFOLLOW) fallback; lexical rejection of '..', absolute paths, empty components, NUL, and remote URIs; fstat regular-file + world-writable guard
SHA-256 Digest newtype (hex serde), streaming compute_sha256 via sha2, constant-time verify_sha256 -> ErrorCode::DigestMismatch
ArtifactStore (per-tenant roots <base>/<tenant>), open_artifact() with optional foreign-owner uid check, verify_manifest(); Artifact + ArtifactManifest/ManifestEntry types
Crate docs, module wiring, re-exports, end-to-end digest-addressed open+verify test

cargo_test.details: 10 digest + 13 path + 12 store + 1 lib end-to-end + 1 doc-test run; every path test runs in BOTH openat2 and forced-fallback modes via both_modes()

cargo_fmt.details: cargo fmt --all -- --check exit 0 (format_strings rustfmt option is nightly-only and pre-existing; harmless warning)

cargo_clippy.details: clean across all workspace crates and targets

workspace_regression.details: all pre-existing crates (types, errors, lifecycle, transport-contract) still green; no regressions from workspace dep additions

security_fixtures.valid_digest_addressed_file: pass - opens through held fd, computed SHA-256 matches expected
security_fixtures.symlink_escape_to_etc_passwd: pass - ErrorCode::PathEscape (ELOOP via RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS / O_NOFOLLOW); asserts no file outside tenant root opened
security_fixtures.symlinked_dir_component: pass - ErrorCode::PathEscape (ENOTDIR mapped to PathEscape on this kernel)
security_fixtures.foreign_owner_file: pass - ErrorCode::PermissionDenied (fstat st_uid vs expected uid)
security_fixtures.remote_uri: pass - ErrorCode::PathEscape for https://, oci://, docker://, s3://, file://
security_fixtures.cross_tenant_isolation: pass - tenant-2 open fails closed with ArtifactNotFound, tenant-1 succeeds
security_fixtures.magic_link: guarded by RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS (not materializable in a tempdir fixture; see not_tested)

qa_scenarios.failure: cargo test -p microvm-artifacts path::tests::rejects_symlink_escape -> 1 passed (no file outside tenant root opened)

not_tested: live /proc magic-link fixture (procfs-only; guarded by RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS)
BLAKE3 manifest variant (plan mentions SHA-256/BLAKE3; SHA-256 implemented per task requirements)
real pre-5.6 ENOSYS kernel (fallback covered by forcing with_openat2_disabled, not a live ENOSYS host)
